calibration.about: The raw-or-log detector's frozen calibration (research/benchmark/protocol-value-scale.md, amendment 5): per calibrated stratum and class, the umbrella k-th smallest calibration score (the class probability of each deposit's subsample, or of its constructed log variant). Written once by valuescale/corpus/calibrate.py; never edited.

owner_accepted.decided: 2026-11-07, the owner: "Accept, fix, calibrate" (the variants fault fixed test first, the design part re-run, then the calibration)

report.guarantee: For tables like the 68 calibration deposits of this stratum (public processed protein tables, linear as deposited, and constructed logs of them), the right reading is missing from the answer at most 5% of the time, with 95% confidence (protein-v1).
